description.value: IGA Enderby is a full-service neighbourhood supermarket on Russell Avenue in the small city of Enderby, situated in the Okanagan-Shuswap region along a popular cycle touring corridor. Operating under the IGA Stores of BC banner, it offers a comprehensive range of departments including a bakery, in-house butcher, deli with ready-to-eat meals, fresh produce, dairy, and wellness products. For touring cyclists moving through the Thompson-Okanagan, it represents one of the more complete resupply options in the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at igastoresbc.com/find-a-store/enderby-iga loaded successfully and confirms this is the Enderby IGA, described as 'Your Neighborhood Grocery Store for Fresh Food,' with extensive department listings matching the OSM bakery=yes and butcher=yes tags. No bike parking, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. The website's navigation header persistently references 'IGA Vancouver (Burrard St.)' for pickup, which appears to be a chain-wide default and does not affect the validity of this Enderby listing.
concerns: Website navigation persistently displays 'Reserve Pickup Time at IGA Vancouver (Burrard St.)' as a chain-wide default header, which could cause confusion but does not affect the validity of the Enderby listing.
OSM address lacks city and postal code; only street number and street name are present in the tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating grocery supermarket in Enderby, BC with a live website; a clear and valuable resupply stop for touring cyclists in the Okanagan-Shuswap region.

wow_evidence: bakery, in-house butcher, deli with ready-to-eat meals, fresh produce
